export { ScrollArea } from './components/ScrollArea';

note: ScrollArea rebuilt as a compound family (root + ScrollViewport + Scrollbar + ScrollThumb). All parts live in the same css family 'scroll-area' (whole-directory split), so no other registry/manifest changes are needed for the parts.

ScrollArea is no longer RSC-safe: the rebuilt root uses hooks (useState/Children) and the barrel re-exports it. Keeping the entries would falsely publish hook-using modules as server-importable. No new entries needed (scroll-math.ts / ScrollAreaContext.ts are conservative-absent; a 'use client' banner on them is harmless).
